category_definitions.held_then_dropped: Scaffold held for a pause that never came inside the horizon.
category_definitions.superseded: A newer juncture replaced a scaffold that was still waiting.
category_definitions.suppressed_submission: A submission produced no evaluate scaffold because the episode budget or cooldown was active. This is the most costly silence, since a submission is the clearest moment to ask for a self-check.
category_definitions.thin_evidence: Scaffold delivered from a window holding very few events, so the stated reason rests on almost no observation.
category_definitions.abandoned_after: Learner produced no further event within 30 minutes, so the scaffold could not be acted on in that session.
category_definitions.late_delivery: The gate delayed the scaffold by more than 120 s past the juncture that triggered it, so it may no longer match what the learner is doing.
